crossRefs.note: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of…
Their south border was from the uttermost part of the Salt Sea, from the bay that looks southward;

people.name: Akrabbim
people.line: A pass marking the southern border of Judah

people.name: Amorites
people.line: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel

people.name: Sela
people.line: Edomite stronghold captured by King Amaziah of Judah

translations.web: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
translations.bsb: And the border of the Amorites extended from the Ascent of Akrabbim to Sela and beyond.
translations.kjv: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
translations.asv: And the border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
